accepted.package: picomatch <=4.0.7, through vite, tinyglobby and fdir
accepted.reason: ReDoS on crafted glob patterns. Only Vite's build reaches picomatch, with globs from our own config, never from users; nothing of it ships in the app. No fixed picomatch release exists, and npm's suggested fix is a downgrade of Vite 8 to 6.
